summary: Web app project with an admin area that has a persistent backend connection timeout issue.
known_issues: Admin area is inaccessible due to backend connection timeout ('Die Verbindung zum Backend hat zu lange gedauert')

existing_features.title: Fix the Admin Dashboard access failure caused by backend connection timeout. The `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout` hook and the actor initialization in `useActor.ts` must be coordinated so that the admin status check only fires after the authenticated actor is fully ready. Eliminate any race condition between Internet Identity login completion and the admin check query being enabled.

Ensure the backend actor in `useActor.ts` is always instantiated using the authenticated Internet Identity principal when the user is logged in. The actor must not fall back to an anonymous identity while an authenticated identity is available, which would cause admin-gated backend calls to fail silently or time out.
